who.title: Who we are
who.body: This website belongs to {legalName} ("{business}"), {area}. {business} decides how guests' personal data is used: it is the data controller.
who.processor: The website is built and run for {business} by {processor} ({platform}), which acts as data processor.

collect.title: What this site collects
collect.body: You can browse this site without giving any personal data. It sets no cookies, runs no analytics and shows no ads.
collect.logs: Like every website, our hosting provider briefly keeps technical logs (IP address, page, time and browser) to run and protect the service.

booking.title: Booking requests and messages
booking.body: When you use "Check availability", the details you type (room, dates, guests, payment choice, your name and an optional note) are used for a moment to write your message. Then you send it from your own WhatsApp or email directly to {business}. This website does not store these details. WhatsApp (Meta) or your email provider carry the message under their own terms.
booking.use: {business} uses your message only to answer you and arrange your stay. Calling or writing to {business} works the same way.

where.title: Where data is kept
where.body: This website is served by: {hosting}. The details you send are kept in {business}'s WhatsApp or email, not on this website.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Law No. 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy, you may ask {business} for access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, object to its use, and ask to move it. Contact {business} using the details above.
rights.complain: You can also complain to the National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA), Data Protection and Privacy Office (dpo.gov.rw).

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We will update this notice when the site starts to collect more, for example a booking inbox once it is authorised. The date at the top shows the latest version.
